title: 第17章 九品真龙血丹千万斤巨力第18章 命轮二层一千五百万斤巨力谁人可敌
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
序列府偏院。
床榻之上，容貌绝美的女子正盘坐其上，周身散发着让万道臣服的气息。
这股气息仿若无上至尊，万族匍匐跪拜。
顾清秋缓缓睁开双眸，一缕金光从眸中一闪而逝：“一个月，化液六层，还算可以，明日便是虚空秘境的成人礼试炼，我这个修为勉强可以插手那《龙象功》机缘。”
顾清秋说罢，目光又看向家主府。
“一个月，不知道顾长歌突破命轮二层没有，不过一层二层都没有差距，他独入命轮，已经暂时形成断层了。”
“上辈子顾长歌突破命轮，貌似是成人礼试炼一个月之后吧。”
“变故太大了！”
“不止如此，顾长歌还觉醒了第二天赋，并且这个第二天赋还跟“仙”
有关！”
顾清秋说着，蓦然像是感知到了什么，周身化液气息逐渐隐匿，取而代之是变成了孕灵境五层！
一个月前，顾清秋三天从开脉突破孕灵，如今从孕灵一层展露出孕灵境五层实力，一个月时间突破四层也是逆天至极了。
但顾清秋真正实力可是化液境六层！
重生至尊并不是开玩笑的。
做完这一切，顾清秋起身走出房间，一名容貌稚嫩但已经初显出尘之姿的少年，正背负双手，站在了院落中央，当看到顾清秋出来，他俊朗的脸上挂着温和的笑容。
顾长歌看着顾清秋，一个月不见，少女从一开始的稚嫩好似变得成熟了一点，并且气质更为高贵出尘。
一个月改变这么大！
顾长歌总感觉顾清秋现在就已经极为不凡，心中一动，打开了顾清秋面板。
【昵称：顾清秋】
【身份：长生顾家支脉之女、重生至尊】

【实力：化液境六层！
【体质：至尊骨！
【功法：虚空经！
【神通：虚空大手印！
虚空罡气，大虚空术，虚空切割，虚空凝固】
【近期运势：……】
一一扫过顾清秋面板，当顾长歌看到顾清秋实力一栏，顿时微微瞪大眼睛。
不是！
一个月从孕灵境一层，突破到化液境六层了？
一个大境界，六个小境界？
这就是重生至尊的逆天之处？
内心震动，不过顾长歌面色依旧保持之前的样子，他看着走出来的顾清秋，笑道：“清秋妹妹，一个月不见，又漂亮了很多。”
“神子哥哥。”
顾清秋摇摇头，“神子哥哥才是更加出尘绝世了，如同谪仙，而且气息越发深邃。”
实则他的内心也在震惊。
因为不止她进步了，顾长歌进步也是难以想象，不止实力突破命轮二层，顾清秋还从顾长歌身上感受到了淡淡的仙灵复苏气息，周身那出尘仙光，便是仙骨觉醒的特征。
顾清秋说着，双眸微微一凝，好似看到了顾长歌胸口那里盘坐了一尊镇压世间万物的虚影。
“嗡”
刹那，这尊虚影蓦然睁开了双眼，一股恐怖波动，瞬间撞在顾清秋心神之上，纵使她有帝境灵魂，亦是连连后退数步，面色苍白。
content_en:
The side courtyard of Sequence Mansion.
On the bed, a woman with extremely beautiful appearance was sitting cross-legged on it, exuding an aura that made all people surrender.
This breath is like a supreme being, and all races kneel down in worship.
Gu Qingqiu slowly opened his eyes, and a ray of golden light flashed from his eyes: "One month, six levels of liquid transformation, not bad. Tomorrow is the adult ceremony trial in the Void Secret Realm. With my cultivation level, I can barely participate in the "Dragon Elephant Skill" opportunity."
After Gu Qingqiu said that, he looked towards the head of the family's palace again.
"In one month, I don't know if Gu Changge has broken through the second level of the Life Wheel, but there is no difference between the first and the second level. He entered the Life Wheel alone, and a gap has been temporarily formed."
"In his previous life, Gu Changge broke through the Wheel of Life, seemingly one month after the coming-of-age ceremony trial."
"What a big change!"
"Not only that, Gu Changge also awakened his second talent, and this second talent is also related to the "immortal"
Related! "
As Gu Qingqiu spoke, he suddenly seemed to sense something. The liquid aura around his body gradually disappeared, and instead it became the fifth level of the Pregnant Spirit Realm!
A month ago, Gu Qingqiu had broken through the pregnant spirit from the first level of pregnant spirit in three days. Now he showed the strength of the fifth level of pregnant spirit realm. Breaking through the fourth level in one month was extremely unbelievable.
But Gu Qingqiu's true strength is at the sixth level of Liquid Realm!
Reborn Supreme is no joke.
After doing all this, Gu Qingqiu stood up and walked out of the room. A young man with an immature appearance but who was already showing his early appearance was standing in the center of the courtyard with his hands behind his back. When he saw Gu Qingqiu coming out, a gentle smile appeared on his handsome face.
Gu Changge looked at Gu Qingqiu. After not seeing him for a month, the girl seemed to have become a little more mature from her immature appearance, and her temperament was more noble.
Such a big change in one month!
Gu Changge always felt that Gu Qingqiu was already extremely extraordinary, so he opened the Gu Qingqiu panel with a thought.
[Nickname: Gu Qingqiu]
[Identity: Daughter of a branch of the Gu family of Changsheng, reborn supreme]
[Strength: Sixth Level of Liquid Realm!
[Physique: Supreme Bone!
[Exercise: Void Sutra!
[Supernatural power: Mahamudra of the Void!
Void Gangqi, Great Void Technique, Void Cutting, Void Solidification]
[Recent fortune:...]
Scanning Gu Qingqiu's panels one by one, when Gu Changge saw the column of Gu Qingqiu's strength, his eyes widened slightly.
no!
Breaking through from the first level of the Pregnant Spirit Realm to the sixth level of the Liquid Transformation Realm in one month?
One big realm, six small realms?
Is this the incredible thing about the Reborn Supreme?
His heart was shaken, but Gu Changge's expression remained the same as before. He looked at Gu Qingqiu who came out and said with a smile: "Sister Qingqiu, I haven't seen you for a month, and you have become much more beautiful."
"Brother Shenzi."
Gu Qingqiu shook his head, "Brother Shenzi is even more extraordinary, like a banished immortal, and his aura is getting deeper and deeper."
In fact, he was also shocked inside.
Because not only did she improve, but Gu Changge's progress was also unimaginable. Not only did his strength break through the second level of the Life Wheel, Gu Qingqiu also felt a faint aura of fairy revival from Gu Changge. The immortal light around him was the characteristic of the awakening of fairy bones.
As Gu Qingqiu spoke, his eyes narrowed slightly, as if he saw a shadow sitting cross-legged on Gu Changge's chest that suppressed all things in the world.
"Buzz"
In an instant, the phantom suddenly opened its eyes, and a wave of terror hit Gu Qingqiu's mind instantly. Even though she had an emperor-level soul, she took several steps back and turned pale.
